mutations.label: the coalescer counts the pass already done or reading as covering a new caller, so an idle caller returns without running any pass at all; the test fails at once on that first caller instead of hanging on it (#473, #970)

the coalescer satisfies a caller with the pass that was already reading when it arrived, while an idle caller still runs its own, so a change landing mid-pass is answered before anything reconciled it (#473)
the pack runs its own full pass per request again instead of sharing, which is the O(N) per create the straight line of #473 is made of
the uplink queue is no longer drained, so every concurrent create pays its own uplink write and firewall rebuild again (#473)
the write deadline goes back to sixty seconds under a machine runtime, the figure that cut six completed creates on the ztiac replay (#473)

the coalescer stops counting the callers it parks: Waiting stays at 0 while a caller sleeps on the running pass, so TestALateCallerNeedsAPassOfItsOwn's poll for a parked caller never ends; it now fails on awaitParked within testWait (10 s) instead of spinning until the package timeout (#963). The 40 s timeout makes a hang read HUNG, so a bite means red inside 40 s. Measured by hand on 2026-11-15 in a copy (go test -overlay, -race, -timeout 40s): with the bounded waits, FAIL TestALateCallerNeedsAPassOfItsOwn (10.00s) naming `the in-time caller never parked on pass 1: Waiting is 0, want 1`; with main 3a45c83's bare waits, `panic: test timed out after 40s`

a pass that ends wakes nobody: the Broadcast is dropped, so the caller parked on pass 1 sleeps forever and pass 2 never begins, a deadlock in the subject; the test now fails on awaitClosed within testWait (10 s) naming the pass that never began, instead of hanging on a bare receive (#963). The 40 s timeout makes a hang read HUNG, so a bite means red inside 40 s. Measured by hand on 2026-11-15 in a copy (go test -overlay, -race, -timeout 40s): with the bounded waits, FAIL TestALateCallerNeedsAPassOfItsOwn (10.01s) naming `pass 2 never began once pass 1 ended, so the parked caller was never woken`; with main 3a45c83's bare waits, `panic: test timed out after 40s`

the pack's side of the same deadlock: a coalescer pass that ends wakes nobody, so the five subnet creates parked on the held isolation pass never return; the pack's test now fails on awaitSubject within five seconds naming the burst callers, instead of hanging on a bare receive (#963). The 30 s timeout makes a hang read HUNG, so a bite means red inside 30 s. Measured by hand on 2026-11-15 in a copy (go test -overlay, -race, -timeout 30s): with the bounded waits, FAIL TestConcurrentSubnetCreatesShareTheirIsolationPasses (5.01s), `the burst callers never all returned once the held pass ended`; with main 3a45c83's bare receives, `panic: test timed out after 30s`
